gameDescriptionHtml:
CLASSIC PLATFORMING FUN!

Take control of a robot named Bolt in 48 levels of 3D platforming fun Inspired by the golden age of platform games. It is a collect-a-thon at heart and rewards the player constantly in a vibrant and evolving hub world!

Game Features

  • STORY – Two shops are fighting for customers on the same street. One is called Bolt’s Bit’s and Bot’s and the other is Mr Coin’s Treasure Cove. When the evil Mr Coin realizes Bolt’s shop is doing more business than his, he releases a virus which infects all of Bolt’s products. Bolt then has to enter each one of his toy like models and repair everything inside to increase his store rating!
  • TOOLS AND UPGRADES – Bolt is both a skilled mechanic and inventive genius, so he has many different tools and contraptions at his disposal, such as a spanner to fix things with and a whip to reach higher locations. His trusty sky wing also makes an appearance, so that he can safely glide around in style!
  • BIT’S AND BOT’S – The main hub world in the game is called Bit’s and Bot’s. Every collectible found in each level of the game is tied to it. The more you collect, the more the shop becomes alive and joyful! Viruses have infected Bolt’s products and need to be removed. Removing every single one from a product will reward you with a shiny collectible card, which can be displayed and viewed from one of the stores many card holder stands. There is a total of 48 cards to collect!
  • BONUS LEVELS! – No waiting around for bonus levels to unlock! Collecting all the scrap in only two levels rewards you with a brand new and unique challenge! One bonus level has Bolt jumping through a massive tv screen and trying to stop the tv channels from counting down and in another he is chased by one of Mr Coins minions in a vehicle modded with deadly saw blades. 3D Platformer completionists will be surprised and delighted each time during their 15 – 20 hour playthrough!
  • DIFFICULTY MODES – The game includes two difficulty modes, Casual and Retro! Casual Mode – This mode is for players looking for a more peaceful and cozy experience. If you enjoy the calmness of playing as a certain purple dragon, then Casual Mode is for you. Retro Mode – This mode is for gamers who are looking for a more challenging experience. If you like the thrill you get whilst playing as a certain bandicoot, then retro mode is for you. All 26 Steam Achievements are achievable on both difficulty settings!
  • CONTROLLER SUPPORT – Playable with a Mouse and Keyboard or with the Xbox Controller. (Dualshock Controllers and Third Party Controllers are not supported yet.)
  • STEAM DECK COMPATIBILITY – 100% Playable! After clicking start with the touch screen or touch-pad Bolt Bot is fully playable from start to finish. Cloud Saves – Unfortunately, cloud saves are not possible, so please choose either the PC or Steam Deck for your playthrough.
